en.name: Draco Malfoy
en.ability: Each night, both an evil player (Lucius if in play) and a good player, may guess who you are. You permanently turn the alignment of whoever correctly guesses you first. (Good guesses first)

revisions.v1: Each night, both an evil player (Lucius if in play) and a good player, may guess who you are. You permanently turn the alignment of whoever correctly guesses you first. (Good guesses first)

en.flavor: Didn't mummy ever tell you it was rude to eavesdrop, Potter?
en.firstNightReminder: Wake the Good Recruiter (If Alive) and show them the Draco Malfoy character token, ask them to choose a player. Wake the Evil Recruiter (If Alive) and show them the Draco Malfoy character token, ask them to choose a player, even if Draco has been successfully guessed.
